title: A requirement of specific material composition is set aside as incompatible

statements.text: The proposal that consciousness depends on material composition, such as metabolism at the nanometer scale, is incompatible with computational functionalism, so the report sets it aside. Requirements framed by conditions outside the system, such as agency and embodiment, are kept only as the computational features they imply.

sources.quote: The proposal that consciousness depends on material composition is clearly incompatible with computational functionalism, so we can set it aside.
